Record a decision

A worksheet for an individual decision, a team discussion or a proposal.

Our project

Output, contributors, timeframe and available support:

Our decision

Which one rule, task or action are we agreeing on?

Our reasons

Which concrete finding or need supports this decision? What are we only assuming?

Responsible role and prerequisite

Who takes on the task? Which support or commitment is still missing?

Action status

Open / planned / agreed / checked. A plan is not yet a completed test.

Our completion check

How will we know the next person can work with the result?

Next review

When, and after which event, will we review this again?
